payload.because: The operator wants sofar to stand out from native and competitors by a large margin, not to close gaps with patches. This continues the run owner's 2026-09-15 direction (bench-refresh note).
payload.chose: Every r3-fixes fix starts with a written internet survey of prior art and best practice. It ranks the options, including a new method or algorithm of our own where none is good enough. The fix states a predicted margin over native and competitors before it is built.
payload.over: Patching each loss directly from our own diagnosis
payload.quote: make sure we research thoroughly on the internet for the possible best solutions and practices. We can invent new technology or we can invent new methods or an algorithm... We have to stand out from them in a huge number
payload.rule: Before fixing any loss, research the internet thoroughly for the best solutions and practices, and consider inventing a new technology, method or algorithm, so sofar stands out from native and competitors by a huge margin.
